name: Baldur's Gate 3
description: Build a party, shape a story through your choices, and explore a turn-based fantasy role-playing adventure.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Baldur's Gate 3.
whyVisit: A richly reactive campaign where party builds, dialogue choices, and tactical encounters shape each playthrough.

name: Hades
description: Fight through the Underworld in a fast action roguelike with evolving characters and Greek-myth-inspired storytelling.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Hades.
whyVisit: Tight combat and a story that unfolds across repeated escape attempts make each run feel purposeful.

name: Elden Ring
description: Explore the Lands Between in a challenging open-world action RPG filled with dungeons, secrets, and formidable foes.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Elden Ring.
whyVisit: A huge world rewards curiosity, while build variety gives players many ways to approach its demanding fights.

name: Cyberpunk 2077
description: Play as V, a mercenary in Night City, in an open-world science-fiction RPG driven by characters and player choices.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Cyberpunk 2077.
whyVisit: Night City's dense districts and character-led quests make it a strong pick for players who like exploratory RPGs.

name: Stardew Valley
description: Restore a farm, build relationships, explore caves, and make a life in a relaxed countryside simulation.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Stardew Valley.
whyVisit: Flexible days let players focus on farming, friendships, exploration, or a little of everything.

name: Hollow Knight
description: Descend into Hallownest, a hand-drawn underground kingdom built around precise combat and interconnected exploration.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Hollow Knight.
whyVisit: Its interconnected map, memorable bosses, and atmospheric world reward patient exploration.

name: Celeste
description: Guide Madeline up Celeste Mountain through precise platforming challenges and a personal story.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Celeste.
whyVisit: Responsive controls and optional assist settings make a demanding platformer approachable on the player's terms.

name: Portal 2
description: Solve physics-based test chambers with a portal device, alone or in a separate cooperative campaign.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Portal 2.
whyVisit: Clever spatial puzzles and a distinct sense of humor make its single-player and co-op modes standouts.

name: It Takes Two
description: Team up as Cody and May in a two-player adventure where every level introduces a new cooperative mechanic.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for It Takes Two.
whyVisit: It is designed entirely around two-player teamwork, with a steady stream of changing abilities and set pieces.

name: Overcooked! 2
description: Coordinate a kitchen crew through chaotic levels in a cooperative cooking game for up to four players.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Overcooked! 2.
whyVisit: Short rounds and escalating kitchen layouts make it an easy group game with plenty of room for teamwork.

name: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
description: Lead a civilization from early settlement to a world power in a turn-based 4X strategy game.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Sid Meier's Civilization VI.
whyVisit: A wide range of leaders and victory paths supports long, thoughtful campaigns with a satisfying one-more-turn rhythm.

name: Slay the Spire
description: Build a card deck and adapt your route through a single-player roguelike deck-building climb.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Slay the Spire.
whyVisit: Readable turn-based combat and deck synergies make each climb a compact test of planning and adaptation.

name: Forza Horizon 5
description: Race and explore across an open-world version of Mexico in a festival-themed driving game.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Forza Horizon 5.
whyVisit: A large car roster and open-world events suit both structured races and relaxed free-roaming.

name: DOOM Eternal
description: Fight through a high-speed first-person shooter campaign as the Doom Slayer confronts Hell's forces.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for DOOM Eternal.
whyVisit: Aggressive movement and weapon switching keep its combat loop fast, focused, and skill-driven.

name: No Man's Sky
description: Explore a procedurally generated universe through spaceflight, planetary discovery, crafting, and survival.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for No Man's Sky.
whyVisit: Its broad mix of exploration, base building, and multiplayer gives players room to choose their own pace.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: Track monsters and navigate political conflicts as Geralt in a story-driven open-world fantasy RPG.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt.
whyVisit: Character-driven quests and a detailed world make it a strong choice for long-form fantasy storytelling.

name: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut
description: Investigate a murder as a troubled detective in a dialogue-heavy role-playing game shaped by player choices.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Disco Elysium - The Final Cut.
whyVisit: Its skill system and conversations let players shape an unusual detective story without relying on traditional combat.

name: The Sims 4
description: Create Sims, build homes, and guide everyday stories in a life simulation sandbox.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for The Sims 4.
whyVisit: Open-ended household stories and building tools make it a flexible creative game with a free base game.

name: Apex Legends
description: Choose a Legend and squad up for a free-to-play team-based battle royale shooter.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Apex Legends.
whyVisit: Distinct character abilities and squad-based play add tactical choices to its competitive battle royale matches.

name: Terraria
description: Dig, build, craft, and fight through a 2D sandbox adventure shaped by exploration and progression.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Terraria.
whyVisit: Its tools, biomes, and progression open up a huge range of ways to play alone or with friends.

name: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
description: Explore Los Santos in Rockstar's open-world action game, with a story campaign and the evolving GTA Online world.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced.
whyVisit: A detailed open world combines a story campaign with the ongoing multiplayer activities of GTA Online.

name: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: Follow outlaw Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang across a vast open-world action-adventure story.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Red Dead Redemption 2.
whyVisit: A character-focused western story sits inside a richly detailed world built for both missions and free exploration.

name: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
description: Fight through a reimagined Sengoku-era Japan as a shinobi in a precision-focused action adventure.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice.
whyVisit: Its posture-and-parry combat rewards timing and observation in tense, skill-based encounters.

name: Resident Evil 4
description: Join Leon S. Kennedy on a rescue mission that blends survival horror, exploration, and action combat.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Resident Evil 4.
whyVisit: Resource-conscious combat and steadily escalating set pieces make this survival-horror adventure consistently tense.

name: Monster Hunter: World
description: Track and hunt formidable creatures, then use gathered materials to craft equipment for tougher expeditions.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Monster Hunter: World.
whyVisit: Distinct weapon styles and cooperative hunts give each expedition a satisfying preparation-to-reward loop.

name: Left 4 Dead 2
description: Team up with up to three other survivors in a cooperative first-person shooter set during a zombie outbreak.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Left 4 Dead 2.
whyVisit: Campaigns built around teamwork and unpredictable encounters make it a durable choice for a group session.

name: Counter-Strike 2
description: Compete in objective-based tactical shooter matches built around precise gunplay and coordinated teams.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Counter-Strike 2.
whyVisit: Round-based objectives and clear team roles put communication, map knowledge, and execution at the center.

name: Dota 2
description: Choose from a large roster of heroes and compete in a free-to-play team-based multiplayer online battle arena.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Dota 2.
whyVisit: Its deep hero roster and team objectives offer a high skill ceiling for players who enjoy strategic multiplayer.

name: Dead Cells
description: Battle through a shifting island in a fast action platformer with roguelite progression and branching routes.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Dead Cells.
whyVisit: Responsive combat and varied routes make each run a compact action challenge with persistent unlocks.

name: Undertale
description: Find your way home through an underground world where encounters can be handled with fighting or compassion.
imageAlt: Official Steam store artwork for Undertale.
whyVisit: Its memorable characters and flexible approach to encounters give the story a distinctive, player-shaped feel.
